summary: Cul-de-sac head kerb backed by hedge and bush, houses 13-25 m away.
reasons: Backs onto dense planting and path

drivers.seclusion: Dense trees and a path behind the kerb; buildings tagged only 'yes' sit 13-25 m away and are probably homes or outbuildings.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide turning circle with a sealed apron, room to pull in clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Cars park around the head and a building site sits just east; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Slope about 3.5% mean, up to 7.6% max
Building works vehicles near the east end
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over the kerb, mainly from the north and west.

best_section.where: Northern kerb of the turning circle, beside the hedge and footpath
